test_title: RRB Technician Grade III Official Paper (Held On: 30 Dec, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following budgets announced the release of 109 high-yielding and climate- resilient varieties of 32 field and horticulture crops?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Union Budget 2024-25**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The release of **109 high-yielding and climate-resilient varieties** of **32 field and horticulture crops** was announced under the **Union Budget 2024-25**.
 
• This initiative aims to address the challenges posed by **climate change** and ensure sustainable agricultural practices.
 
• The high-yielding varieties are designed to help farmers achieve **higher productivity** even under adverse climatic conditions.
 
• Such resilient varieties are expected to reduce crop losses due to **droughts, floods, and pest infestations**.
 
• It also supports the government’s agenda of promoting **self-reliance (Atmanirbhar Bharat)** in agriculture.
 
• These measures align with the broader goals of enhancing **food security** and ensuring the welfare of farmers.
 
• Additionally, it reflects the government's commitment to achieving **sustainable development goals (SDGs)**, particularly those related to **zero hunger** and **climate action**.
